writeup: TIC 290129286 is a newly discovered eclipsing binary star system with an orbital period of 1.778041 days. The primary eclipse causes the system to dim by 15.56 percent, while no secondary eclipse has been detected. This candidate was identified through automated analysis of survey data and shows a strong detection signal with a signal-to-noise ratio of 256.7. The system does not appear in any of six major variable-star catalogs, making it a genuinely novel discovery. Although difference imaging revealed a small offset from the target location, further analysis confirmed the detection. The alternating pattern in eclipse depths provided crucial confirmation of the true orbital period, distinguishing this system from false positives.
